description: Uses Cognigy's generative AI to create content for Say nodes. Generates either plain text messages or rich Adaptive Cards based on a natural language prompt. Returns content you can use with create_node or update_node.

flowId.description: The flow ID (used for context, e.g., persona settings)

generateContentLimit.description: Maximum number of text variations to generate (for text output type, 1-10)

lastOutput.description: Previous generation result to refine or continue from

localeId.description: The locale ID for language-appropriate generation

outputType.description: Type of content to generate: 'text' for plain Say messages, 'adaptiveCard' for rich interactive cards

prompt.description: Natural language description of what content to generate (e.g., 'greeting message for a banking bot', 'poll for scheduling a meeting')

name: generate_node_output
